title: Graduate Engineer
abstract: Graduate Engineer to join experienced civil crew completing flood restoration works throughout South East Queensland and Northern New South Wales.
bullets: Gain experience working under an experienced team.
Accommodation and Living Away from Home Allowance (LAHA) provided.
Accelerate your career with hands-on site experience.
screening_questions: Do you own or have regular access to a car?
Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
Do you have experience using Microsoft Excel?
Do you hold a Construction Induction Safety certificate (White Card)?
Have you worked in a role which requires a sound understanding of OH&S/WHS?
How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
Do you have a current Australian driver's licence?
Are you willing to relocate for this role?
content_text:
We are currently undertaking slope stabilisation works throughout South East Queensland and Northern New South Wales for various local and state government entities. 
For this job role, you will be expected to complete following daily tasks:
- Generating and completing Inspection and Test Plans (ITPS).
- Creating lots and logging data in to quality assurance system.
- Collecting and recording plant and labour dockets in excel.
- Material procurement. 
- Reporting to site engineer/ project engineer.
A central shared site house will be provided, but candidate will be expected to provide their own transport to site. 
You will be supported by an experienced crew who will be able to guide you as you develop your skills in the industry.
Works include; soil nails installation, micro-piles, bored piles, rock fall retention netting, rock fall retention fencing, retaining walls.
